summary_en: 300,000 shares (2.73% of S/O); ¥600M upper limit; open-market purchase on TSE; Aug 12, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027; stated purpose: enhanced shareholder returns and flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Rasa Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 300,000 ordinary shares (2.73% of shares outstanding, calculated as 300,000 ÷ 11,005,910) for a maximum outlay of ¥600M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 12 August 2026 and 31 March 2027. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns and to implement flexible capital policy responsive to changing business conditions. The acquisition will be conducted under the Companies Act Article 156, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 165(3), and operates under the authority granted in the articles of incorporation. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 377,928 treasury shares (excluding 371,637 shares held in trust for executive share-grant schemes and 94,206 shares attributable to the company's equity stake in an equity-method affiliate).
